title: Musician Homeowner's Collection Vacation Rental
meta_description: Musician is a 1.00 bedroom, 1.00 bathroom vacation rental.
description_expanded: 121 CENTRAL SQUARE, UNIT E2Luxury Penthouse Living in the Heart of SeasideExperience Seaside, Florida from above at Musician, a newly reimagined luxury penthouse located in the iconic Dreamland Heights building in Central Square. Positioned directly across from the beach and the Seaside Amphitheater, this rare third-floor retreat offers front-row access to Seaside’s most beloved shops, restaurants, and events—all just steps from your door.Elevated Arrival with Iconic Gulf ViewsArrive via elevator and step into a spacious shared outdoor terrace overlooking the Gulf of Mexico, Bud & Alley’s, Pickle’s, and other Seaside favorites. This elevated vantage point immediately sets the tone for your stay, offering sweeping views and a true sense of place before you even enter the residence.Freshly Renovated Coastal InteriorInside, Musician has been renovated down to the studs, creating a bright, airy interior filled with natural light. The first level features a beautifully designed, fully renovated kitchen blending modern finishes with coastal charm. The kitchen includes a full-size Sub-Zero refrigerator, compact dishwasher, Miele mini oven, and a full-size Miele four-burner electric cooktop, along with a dining area for two—perfect for morning coffee or intimate meals.Serene King Suite with Private BalconyJust off the kitchen is the tranquil king primary suite, designed for rest and relaxation. The suite includes blackout curtains, a wall-mounted flat-screen TV, and direct access to a private open-air balcony. The adjacent bathroom features elegant marble floors, a single vanity, and a glass-enclosed marble shower with a rain shower head. Step outside to the balcony’s bar-top dining for four and enjoy rooftop views with a glimpse of the Gulf beyond.Open-Concept Living with Coastal ViewsThe second level opens to a thoughtfully styled living space overlooking the first floor, creating a light-filled, open atmosphere. This level features a comfortable sofa with a queen sleeper, additional seating, and a large mounted flat-screen TV—ideal for relaxing after a day at the beach or enjoying an evening in Seaside.Private Rooftop Deck with Panoramic Gulf ViewsA final staircase leads to the show-stopping private rooftop deck, offering some of the most breathtaking views in Seaside. From here, take in 360-degree panoramic vistas of the Gulf of Mexico, Seaside rooftops, treetops, The Court boutique hotel, and Central Square. The rooftop is furnished with bar seating for two and chaise loungers for two, making it the ultimate setting for sunset cocktails, sunbathing, or simply soaking in the magic of Seaside.An Unforgettable Seaside EscapeWith its unmatched location, brand-new renovations, and elevated indoor-outdoor living, Musician is a truly rare penthouse experience in Seaside, Florida. Whether you’re here for beach days, sunset views, or the energy of Central Square, this luxury retreat delivers a one-of-a-kind Seaside vacation.* 3 night minimum Spring, Spring Break, Summer, and 2 night minimum Fall & Winter. Must be 25 years of age to rent and sign registration. FEATURESSeaside Beach Access: Coleman Pavilion with a 2-minute walk (482 feet) to the beachPeacock Alley Linens: Fresh and luxurious Peacock Alley sheets and towels throughout the homeResort-Style Amenities Access: 3 swimming pools, 5 clay tennis courts, 3 pickleball courts (court fees apply), and a fitness centerWelcome tote with two beach towels, a complimentary bottle of wine, and two complimentary rental bikes for pickup at the Seaside Transit AuthorityPersonalized Service: Thoughtful service throughout your stay with starter amenities providedParking & Golf Cart Policy: 1 parking pass per one-bedroom cottage and 2 parking passes for two-bedroom and larger homes. Parking is located behind the building with no assigned spaces and is first come, first serve. A golf cart is considered a car. Golf carts for non-homeowners visiting Seaside are prohibited. Special circumstances and medical needs requests require a golf cart permitNo pets allowed
